Headquarters: Remote, B, Argentina

Job description

About Trafilea

Trafilea is a Consumer Tech Platform for Transformative Brand Growth. We’re building the AI Growth Engine that powers the next generation of consumer brands.

With over $1B+ in cumulative revenue, 12M+ customers, and 500+ talents across 19 countries, we combine technology, growth marketing, and operational excellence to scale purpose-driven, digitally native brands.

We own and operate our own digitally native brands (not an agency), with presence in Walmart, Nordstrom, and Amazon, and a strong global D2C footprint.

Why Trafilea

We’re a tech-led eCommerce group scaling our own globally loved DTC brands, while helping ambitious talent grow just as fast.

We build and scale our own brands.

We invest in AI and automation like few others in eCom.

We test fast, grow fast, and help you do the same.

Be part of a dynamic, diverse, and talented global team.

100% Remote, USD competitive salary, paid time off, and more.

Job Responsibilities

At Trafilea, design is not decoration—it’s performance.

You’ll elevate the brand, ensure consistency across every channel, and push creative boundaries by leveraging AI—while building scalable frameworks and optimizing creative processes to reach millions of customers worldwide.

This is where design meets data, AI, and scale.

  • Create high-performing visual assets for marketing campaigns and digital platforms

  • Design with performance in mind: iterate based on data, not opinions

  • Produce multiple creative variations to support testing and optimization

  • Use AI tools to accelerate ideation, production, and iteration

  • Collaborate with marketing, performance, and product teams

  • Maintain strong brand consistency across all touchpoints

  • Improve workflows using AI and automation

Job requirements

  • 8+ years as a Senior Designer or Design Specialist (flexible for top talent)

  • Experience in fast-paced, high-performance environments

  • Strong portfolio in digital marketing and campaign design

  • Advanced skills in Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, and Figma

  • Comfortable working with AI tools (ChatGPT, Krea, Midjourney, etc.)

  • Strong visual judgment and attention to detail

  • Able to manage multiple projects under tight deadlines

  • Fluent in English

All done!

Your application has been successfully submitted!
